meta.name: brand-voice
meta.description: Build a source-derived writing style profile from real posts, essays, launch notes, docs, or site copy, then reuse that profile across content, outreach, and social workflows. Use when the user wants voice consistency without generic AI writing tropes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从真实内容提取写作风格并复用于多场景
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望品牌在不同渠道保持一致的写作风格。
copy.tagline_en: Extract writing style from real content and reuse it across channels.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want consistent brand voice across all content.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会从你提供的真实帖子、文章、邮件等材料中提取写作风格，生成一个可复用的“声音档案”，并在后续内容创作中自动使用该风格，避免千篇一律的 AI 腔调。
howto.when: 当你需要为社交媒体帖子、邮件、产品文案等保持特定写作风格时触发。

say.text: 帮我从我的 X 帖子中提取写作风格，然后写一条 LinkedIn 更新。
用我上次保存的声音档案写一封冷启动邮件。
say.note: Claude 会复用已有的风格档案生成邮件。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude extracts a writing style from your real posts, essays, emails, etc., creates a reusable 'voice profile', and automatically uses that style in future content to avoid generic AI copy.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need consistent voice for social posts, emails, product copy, etc.

say_en.text: Extract my writing style from my X posts, then write a LinkedIn update.
say_en.note: Claude analyzes your posts and writes in that style.

say_en.text: Use my saved voice profile to write a cold outreach email.
say_en.note: Claude reuses the existing profile to generate the email.
